1289057196-us.description:
Some apps help you post. SCRL helps you create. From structured brand feeds to editorial-style storytelling, SCRL gives you the tools to shape how your social presence is perceived. Whether you're a professional content creator, an artist, or just love sharing your moments, SCRL offers everything you need to make your posts stand out.

• EXCEPTIONAL PHOTO COLLAGE MAKER
SCRL lets you create stunning photo collages with full control over layout, spacing, and visual balance. Move between freeform and structured layouts depending on your workflow - from simple grid collages to complex, layered compositions. SCRL gives you the precision to build exactly what you envision.

• TEMPLATES NO ONE ELSE HAS
A curated library of collage, carousel, and story templates designed in-house by our designers' team. Each one is hand-crafted with focus on composition, proportion, and visual rhythm, not just assembled from generic patterns. Regularly updated with new designs across different styles and use cases.

• PHOTO EDITOR BUILT INTO YOUR WORKFLOW
Adjust exposure, dial in color, apply filters, all without leaving the app. Edit, compose, and publish in one seamless flow. No switching, no quality lost in transit.

• INSTAGRAM CAROUSEL POSTS THAT FLOW
SCRL was designed for creators who think beyond a single post. Build seamless carousels with panoramic layouts, precise alignment, and transitions that flow from slide to slide.

• GRID LAYOUTS FOR A COHESIVE FEED
Multi-post grids that span several photos, giving your feed a structured, unified look. Your profile is a portfolio and SCRL helps it look like one.

• MORE THAN 10 PHOTOS IN ONE POST
Break the limitations of traditional posts & Instagram layouts. With SCRL, you can add more than 10 photos in a single post, providing more room for your creativity and storytelling. 

• FREEFORM CANVAS
Design your way with our freeform canvas. Zoom in and out to perfect every detail or get an overview of your entire project. Create a layout that’s uniquely yours. 

• STICKERS & OVERLAYS
A growing library of overlays and stickers to add texture, depth, and detail to any design. Whatever your style, you’ll find elements that complement your collages and carousels perfectly.

• DIRECT POSTING TO INSTAGRAM & TIKTOK
When it's ready, it goes live - exactly as designed. No exporting, no re-uploading.

• WHERE PROFESSIONAL CONTENT GETS MADE
From property listings to campaign launches, social media schedules to client pitches - SCRL handles the volume without sacrificing the craft.

• SCRL PREMIUM
Every template, every layout, every tool, plus features built for work that demands more. Monthly and yearly plans, starting with a free 7-day trial.

• TRUSTED BY THE BEST
SCRL is trusted by Grammy Award-winning artists, NBA players, and major international music festivals. We’ve been featured numerous times in the App Store and recognized by top industry publications:

"14 Best Apps For Instagram Collages" - Hootsuite
"20 Mobile Apps to Create Stunning Social Media Visuals" - HubSpot
"8 Trendy Apps To Create Collages For Instagram" - Later

TRIAL AND SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Start SCRL Premium Collage Maker with a free 7-day trial. Once the trial is over, you'll be charged an annual subscription fee. SCRL Premium will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 

You can go to your Settings > iTunes Account & App Store > Apple ID > Subscriptions to manage your subscription and turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.

Terms of Use: https://scrl.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://scrl.com/privacy-policy

Follow @scrlgallery on Instagram for inspiration from our community. Add #scrlgallery to your posts to get featured on our page. Questions or feedback? DM us at @scrlgallery.

Create unique photo collages, Instagram stories & carousel posts with SCRL. Browse hundreds of curated templates for every occasion.

1289057196-it.description:
Crea collage fotografici unici e creativi. Con SCRL puoi sovrapporre le tue foto e i tuoi video su più frame per un layout continuo su Instagram. I nostri strumenti di design includono centinaia di templates, immagini stock, font, rimozione dello sfondo e molto altro. Con SCRL, chiunque può creare.

TEMPLATE 
Inizia da un layout di uno dei nostri template di base che danno il via al tuo desig o passa a uno dei nostri layout con prezzi convenienti. La scelta è tutta tua.

CREA DA ZERO 
Aggiungi fino a 10 frame e sfrutta al massimo il tuo layout. Fai zoom in e out per vedere il tuo progetto da vicino o tutto in una volta.

FOTO STOCK GRATUITE 
Libreria di foto stock di Pexels con oltre 1.000.000 di immagini tra cui scegliere.

PUBBLICA SUBITO SUI SOCIAL 
Quando sei pronto, SCRL ti porterà direttamente su Instagram per condividere il tuo lavoro.

SAVA COME VIDEO CONTINUO 
Il tuo design sarà salvato come un video panoramico che scorre automaticamente.

SALVA COME CAROSELLO SCORREVOLE 
Il tuo design sarà salvato come una serie di foto/video che i tuoi follower possono scorrere.

SCRL PREMIUM 
Eleva il tuo design con SCRL Premium e sblocca l'accesso a tutti i nostri template e nuovi contenuti, includi video nei tuoi design, accedi alla libreria di Giphy, utilizza sfondi sfumati, aggiungi dettagli con adesivi e molto altro.

FORSE HAI SENTITO PARLARE DI NOI... 

SCRL è stato utilizzato da artisti vincitori di Grammy, giocatori NBA e festival musicali internazionali mainstream.

In primo piano all'interno dell'App Store numerose volte.

"14 migliori app per collage di Instagram nel 2023" - Hootsuite, agosto 2022
"20 app per creare immagini bellissime per i social media" - HubSpot, agosto 2020
"8 app di tendenza per creare collage per Instagram" - Later, aprile 2019


TERMINI DI PROVA E ABBONAMENTO Abbonati a SCRL Premium con una prova gratuita di 7 giorni. Una volta terminata la prova, ti verrà addebitata una quota di abbonamento annuale.
